title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a series of lines starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0625, 0.0), then to (0.75, 0.0), (0.75, 0.0625), (0.0625, 0.0625), (0.0, 0.0625), and back to the origin. In the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0312, 0.0313) with a radius of 0.0188. Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.0625 units along the normal direction to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, creating a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar with a circular hole are 0.7500000000000001 units in length, 0.06250000000000001 units in width, and 0.06250000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0625, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0625).lineTo(0.0625, 0.0625).lineTo(0, 0.0625).close()

# Create the circular hole
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0312, 0.0313).circle(0.0188)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D model
r = sketch.extrude(0.0625)

# Display the final model

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the rectangular sketch
r = r.box(0.75, 0.0625, 0.0625, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the circular hole sketch
r = r.faces("<Z").workplane().center(0.0312, 0.0312).circle(0.0188)

# Cut the circular hole from the rectangular block
r = r.cutThruAll()

import cadquery as cq

# Rectangular bar: 0.75 long (X), 0.0625 wide (Y), 0.0625 tall (Z)
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.75, 0.0625, 0.0625, centered=(False, False, False))

# Through hole near the left end, centered across the width
hole_dia = 0.045
hole_x = 0.045
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0)) \
     .center(hole_x, 0.0625 / 2.0) \
     .hole(hole_dia)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Long square bar: 0.75 long (X), 0.0625 wide (Y), 0.0625 tall (Z)
bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.75, 0.0625, 0.0625)

# Through hole on the top face near one end, centered across the width
# Hole center is offset from the left end by half the bar width (0.03125)
hole_x = -0.75 / 2 + 0.03125
r = bar.faces(">Z").workplane().move(hole_x, 0).hole(0.03125)
